remarks: ***BEST & FINAL OFFERS DUE BY 2:00PM Wed, 11/27.*** This beautifully updated ranch-style home in desirable New Canaan offers 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 full baths, making it an ideal choice for those seeking modern living in a tranquil setting. The large family room, complete with a cozy fireplace, flows seamlessly into a chef's kitchen featuring stone countertops, a stylish tiled backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and tile flooring. The open-concept layout continues into the dining and living areas, where gleaming hardwood floors and recessed lighting create a bright, inviting atmosphere throughout. The home's thoughtful design includes a primary suite at each end for added privacy. The first primary suite offers a serene retreat with a full bath featuring a tiled shower. Two additional well-sized bedrooms share a beautifully tiled full bath. On the opposite end of the house, the second primary suite is an impressive space, featuring a luxurious full bath with both a tiled shower and a soaking tub for ultimate relaxation. Outside, enjoy a large paver deck that overlooks the fenced-in backyard, perfect for entertaining or simply enjoying the outdoors. A one-car attached garage adds convenience, while the full, enormous basement offers endless potential-ready to be finished for additional living space, playrooms, or home office options. With its prime location, spacious layout, and thoughtful updates, this home combines modern comfort with the charm of New Canaan living.
